about: Answer key for the SAMPLE shipment in samples/sample-shipment. Every company, person, lab and number is fictional (Jewel Labs demo).

howToCompare.paths: "path" is relative to samples/sample-shipment. "inside" names a file inside that zip or email, as ingest names it.
howToCompare.fields: Values are normalized like the reading agent output: dates yyyy-mm-dd, carats and money as plain decimals without separators (5.1, 37274.5), weights "<number> <unit>", HS codes as digits. Compare case-insensitively and ignore spaces and punctuation. "printed" is the same value as printed on the page.
howToCompare.alternatives: Where two field keys fit (the importer on a KP certificate can be consignee.name or buyer.name), "alternatives" lists keys that also count.
howToCompare.lines: One entry per printed row, in order. Match on reportNumber when there is one, else on lineNo. Compare carat as a number within 0.005, colour and clarity case-insensitively, shape by shapeKey (Round, Oval, Princess, Emerald, Cushion, Pear).
howToCompare.checks: expectedChecks use the codes in src/core/rules/compliance.js. expect "absent" means no such requirement should be raised.
